text: {"lessons":["Selling Stocks C and E at losses did not by itself improve my results; I should sell only when my investment case or risk limits justify it, not simply to react to a loss.","I should make each buy—including adding to a position—depend on the stock’s prospects and my portfolio balance, rather than treating a lower or recent price as a reason to buy.","My account value has moved unevenly and is slightly below its starting level, so a few periods are not enough to judge my approach; I should track decisions and compare long-run returns with the market."]}
